title: The AI LinkedIn plan.
description: A LinkedIn plan for AI SaaS founders: five post formats that show how your product actually works, a template and a worked example for each, the weekly posting schedule and a 30-day calendar.
formHeader: Your next month of LinkedIn, planned.
formEyebrow: Get it free, in your inbox
disclosure: You will also get The Draft, one letter a week on how top 1% startups crush organic marketing. Leave whenever you like.

blocks.text: AI companies on LinkedIn all say agentic, 10x and the future of work, so your buyer can't tell any of you apart. This plan gets around that by showing the product doing its job.
I'm a partner at RallyUp, where we write LinkedIn for B2B founders and executives, and this is the plan we'd start an AI SaaS founder on.

items: Teardowns: take something from your buyer's world apart, and let the teardown be the demo
Insider stats: turn what you see across thousands of calls into patterns
Opinions on where AI should touch your buyer's job, and where it shouldn't
The objection crusher: one sales objection per post, answered in public
The monthly direct offer, plus the weekly posting schedule and a 30-day calendar

blocks.text: Every format comes with a fill-in template, a worked example for a made-up AI SaaS and the mistake that kills it. Treat it as a first month you'll adjust, and judge it on saves, DMs and calls booked rather than impressions.
Drop your email below and I'll send it over.
